What this volume contains

The third volume covers the Level A2 "Elementary autonomy": approx. 250 hours of study, from the week 49 to 94 of the calendar. Presumption of Level A1 passed: vocally read texts, build nominal and verbal sentences to the present and past, know cases and about 560 Level words A1.

Level Objectives A2
At the end of the level:
1. use the verbal system of the standard Arabic: perfect, imperfect, future, conjunctive, juxive, imperative, with denials ⁧لَا، لَمْ، لَنْ، لَيْسَ، مَا⁩ ;
2. recognize the root and scheme of a word and search it in the dictionary by root; recognize derived forms II
X and liabilities;
3. build complex phrases: relative, subordinate ( ⁧أَنَّ، لِأَنَّ، عِنْدَمَا، إِذَا⁩ ), with ⁧قَالَ إِنَّ⁩ ;
4. use numbers with names, comparative and superlative, the most frequent plurals;
5. partly vocized text readings of 250–300 words at least 50 words per minute, and notices, forms and e-mail without voice;
6. understand short and slow recordings: messages, service dialogues, a simplified newsletter; recognize the Egyptian and bring him back to the fuṣḥā;
7. write 150 words (story, formal and informal email) with errors that do not prevent understanding;
8. manage practical situations (journey, hotel, doctor, desk) and stories in a conversation of 12 minutes;
9. read and correctly transcribe Arabic names and their variants in documents (track ONO).

These are internal objectives of the course, written on the model of the descriptors of the Common European Framework for Level A2. Passing the exam A2 does not amount to CEFR certification (see "Seals and Evaluation").

blocks.text: Conventions

Transcription. The DIN system is used 31635, as in previous volumes: ā ī ū for long vowels, ṯ ḥ ḫ ḏ š ṣ ḍ ṭ ẓ ġ for consonants without Italian equivalent, ʾ for the hamza, ʿ for the ʿayn, ǧ for the ǧīm. The tables follow the paused reading and the layout of the article (al-baytu) l-kabīr, fī l-bayt), with the assimilation of solar letters (ar- raǧul, aš-šams). For the Egyptian (A2-23) g ( ⁧ج⁩ Egyptian), ʾ even when it comes from ⁧ق⁩ , ē and ō. Vowels, climbing. Layer A2 accompanies you from vocalized to voiceless reading:

rows: complete, with desinences; exercises on securities and notices without voice declared
partial: new words, verbal forms in the studio and where reading is ambiguous

blocks.text: From A2-07 some readings are "without loss": the internal vowels remain, the final vowels of the cases fall; remain the alife of tanwīn -an ( ⁧كتابا⁩ ) and vowel before a suffix ( ⁧عَدَدُهَا⁩ ). Symbols. ★ in the vocabulary indicates a high frequency word to be used actively. ⁧◌⁩ indicates a space to be completed. " (Recognize) " means a form that you must understand but not yet produce. Arabic and Italian on the same line. Arabic can be read from right to left even inside an Italian sentence. When multiple Arabic words are separated only by spaces or punctuation, the layout arranges them from right to left as a single Arabic phrase; where they are separated by ...................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................... Names, cases and news. People, companies, news and volume police cases are invented and serve only for educational purposes; the cases at the police station do not describe operational procedures. In the tracks where real data appear (historical dates, city names) the text says so.
Method

The standard week (standard rhythm, 60 minutes a day): 15 minutes of Anki, 30 lessons and exercises, 15 reading aloud, listening or writing, plus a session of 30–45 minutes a week with the tutor. The two-week units have a plan of 14 days in the initial card. At a light pace every week of the calendar lasts two real weeks; At an intensive pace, the extra time goes to reading and conversation, not to anticipating units. How a unit is made. The structure is the same as theA1: tab (code, level, objectives, prerequisites, time, plan of days), dialogues with transliteration and translation, explanation with tables, pronunciation, new vocabulary with root, category, genre and plural, examples in context, graduated exercises, readings, writing, listening, oral production, errors typical of the italophones, flashcard, final verification and criteria to move to the next unit. The solutions are in Part IV. Exercises and solutions. Always answer in writing before looking at the solutions. In tutor mode the exercises arrive one at a time and the solution is not shown before your answer, except your request. I'm listening. The course does not contain audio recordings. Each listener has a script: ask another person to read it, or paste it into an Arabic synthesizer app without reading it first. Vocal synthesis is useful for the rhythm and recognition of words, but it can fail vowels, endings and the pronunciation of some consonants: the pronunciation of reference is that of the native language tutor. The Egyptian scripts of A2-23 are read by an Egyptian speaker: the vocal synthesis is not reliable for the dialect. From half of theA2 accompany the scripts some authentic slow listening (Appendix C). Anki. The Deck A2 contains all vocabulary entries, with the unit tag and the frequently tagging ★ entries. vowels appearing from theA1 or by Level 0 with new information they have the tag "anche_A"1... or ... ..anche_L.0You can suspend the old card. The deck also contains schema cards (root + schema → word) and plural cards over. New cards per day: 5 at a light pace, 10 Standard, 15 Intensive. The EGY deck is separated, has the [EGY] tag on each card and serves only to recognize: in front of the Egyptian, behind the fuṣḥā and Italian. The dictionary by root. From A2-01 Look for words by root. The reference tool for the italophone is an Arabic-Italian dictionary ordained by root; for Arabic-English, Hans Wehr (Appendix C). Write down in the notebook the root of every new word.

blocks.text: Examination A2 week 94 70/100 and at least 12/20 in each section 2–4 weeks of recovery, then version B of sections not exceeded

Heading (Plan, section 6.3). Five criteria with score from 1 a 4: Accuracy, Fluidity, Understanding, Pronunciation, Register. Each test uses only the relevant criteria. The pronunciation evaluates it as a native language tutor: without tutor the oral part remains open and does not replace with a self-assessment. What does a passed exam say? The exams of the course are self-correct or correct by the tutor: they attest that you have mastered the studied program, not that you possess a certified CEFR level. The end of theA2 is the recommended time for external feedback: the CIMA of the Institut du monde arabe evaluates the standard Arabic in front of an independent examiner. Dates, locations and costs must be verified at the time of registration (Plan, section 6.4; Appendix C).
The track of onomastics

Units ON-01 and ONO-02 teach to read a complete Arabic name (ism, nasab, kunya, laqab, nisba), to recognize its variants of transcription (Mohamed, Muhammad, Mohammed; Abdelkader, ʿAbd al-Qādir) and to return them to Arabic spelling. These are reading and transcription skills. A name says something about the language and conventions of the country of the person who has chosen it, not about the person who carries it: it is never used to deduce religion, origin, opinions or behaviours of someone.

Studying with the tutor
For a guided session, write "Session" followed by the unit code (e.g. "Session" A2-14() and paste the last line of the register. The session always follows the same steps:
1. short recovery of the previous unit;
2. 3–5 quick questions about what you should already know;
3. explanation of the new topic with examples;
4. exercises one at a time, with the solution only after your answer;
5. correction with cause of error and a consolidation exercise;
6. updated log line and targeted review for the following days.

In A2 serve 1–2 sessions per week with a native speaker teacher, also online: for conversation, pronunciation, correction of written productions and reading Egyptian scripts. Oral tests and tests are done with him.
The progress log

The Excel Level file A2 contains the calendar of weeks 49–94 and the log: one line per week with date, units, scores, time spent and notes on errors. It is the source of truth of your journey, independent from any memory of the platform. Always write down: unit verification score, test and exam section scores, address book criteria, timed reading words per minute, dictation percentage and, in the week 93, the decision on dialect.
